counts['month']=pd.to_datetime(counts['month'])
from scipy import sparse
def poisson_twfe_quick(radius, outcome_col, window_months=None):
    import time
    t0=time.time()
    all_months=pd.date_range('2012-07-01','2026-10-01',freq='MS')
    idx=pd.MultiIndex.from_product([sites.site_id.unique(), all_months], names=['site_id','month'])
    panel=pd.DataFrame(index=idx).reset_index()
    panel=panel.merge(sites[['site_id','install_month']], on='site_id', how='left')
    sub=counts[counts.radius_m==radius][['site_id','month',outcome_col]]
    panel=panel.merge(sub,on=['site_id','month'],how='left')
    panel[outcome_col]=panel[outcome_col].fillna(0).astype(int)
    panel['treated']=(panel['month']>=panel['install_month']).astype(int)
    panel['rel']=(panel['month'].dt.year-panel['install_month'].dt.year)*12+(panel['month'].dt.month-panel['install_month'].dt.month)
    if window_months is not None:
        panel=panel[(panel['rel']>=-window_months)&(panel['rel']<=window_months)]
    y=panel[outcome_col].values.astype(float)
    site_ids=panel['site_id'].values
    uniq_sites=np.unique(site_ids)
    site_map={s:i for i,s in enumerate(uniq_sites)}
    site_idx=np.array([site_map[s] for s in site_ids])
    months=panel['month'].values
    uniq_months=np.unique(months)
    month_map={m:i for i,m in enumerate(uniq_months)}
    month_idx=np.array([month_map[m] for m in months])
    treated=panel['treated'].values.astype(float)
    ns=len(uniq_sites); nm=len(uniq_months)
    n=len(panel)
    rows=[]; cols=[]; data=[]
    for i in range(n):
        rows.append(i); cols.append(0); data.append(1.0)
    for i,tr in enumerate(treated):
        if tr!=0:
            rows.append(i); cols.append(1); data.append(tr)
    for i,si in enumerate(site_idx):
        if si<ns-1:
            rows.append(i); cols.append(2+si); data.append(1)
    for i,mi in enumerate(month_idx):
        if mi<nm-1:
            rows.append(i); cols.append(2+(ns-1)+mi); data.append(1)
    X2=sparse.csr_matrix((data,(rows,cols)),shape=(n,2+(ns-1)+(nm-1)))
    p2=X2.shape[1]
    beta=np.zeros(p2)
    for it in range(30):
        eta=X2.dot(beta)
        eta=np.clip(eta,-15,15)
        mu=np.exp(eta); mu=np.clip(mu,1e-8,1e6)
        z=eta+(y-mu)/mu
        w=mu
        sqrtW=np.sqrt(w)
        Xw=X2.multiply(sqrtW[:,None])
        zw=z*sqrtW
        res=sparse.linalg.lsqr(Xw,zw,atol=1e-6,btol=1e-6,iter_lim=2000)
        beta_new=res[0]
        if np.max(np.abs(beta_new-beta))<1e-4:
            beta=beta_new
            break
        beta=beta_new
    # compute clustered SE
    eta=X2.dot(beta); mu=np.exp(np.clip(eta,-15,15))
    resid=y-mu
    XtWX=(X2.T @ sparse.diags(mu) @ X2).toarray()
    try:
        bread=np.linalg.inv(XtWX)
    except:
        bread=np.linalg.pinv(XtWX)
    meat=np.zeros((p2,p2))
    for g in uniq_sites:
        mask=site_ids==g
        Xg=X2[mask].toarray()
        sg=Xg.T @ resid[mask]
        meat+=np.outer(sg,sg)
    V=bread@meat@bread
    se=np.sqrt(np.diag(V))
    coef=beta[1]; se_t=se[1]
    print(f"done r={radius} w={window_months} time {time.time()-t0:.1f}s coef {coef:.3f} se {se_t:.3f}")
    return coef,se_t

def run_twfe(radius, window, outcome, fake_shift=0):
    col='pedestrian_injury_crashes' if outcome=='pedestrian' else 'injury_crashes'
    all_months=pd.date_range('2012-07-01','2026-10-01',freq='MS')
    idx=pd.MultiIndex.from_product([sites.site_id.unique(), all_months], names=['site_id','month_dt'])
    panel=pd.DataFrame(index=idx).reset_index()
    panel=panel.merge(sites[['site_id','install_month_dt']], on='site_id')
    if fake_shift!=0:
        panel['install_month_dt']=panel['install_month_dt']+pd.DateOffset(months=fake_shift)
    cnt=counts[counts.radius_m==radius][['site_id','month_dt',col]].rename(columns={col:'y'})
    panel=panel.merge(cnt, on=['site_id','month_dt'], how='left')
    panel['y']=panel['y'].fillna(0)
    panel['rel']=(panel['month_dt'].dt.year - panel['install_month_dt'].dt.year)*12 + (panel['month_dt'].dt.month - panel['install_month_dt'].dt.month)
    panel_win=panel[panel['rel'].between(-window, window-1)].copy()
    panel_win['treated']=(panel_win['rel']>=0).astype(int)
    panel_win['month_str']=panel_win['month_dt'].dt.strftime('%Y-%m')
    # drop months with no variation? keep
    # Use GLM
    start=time.time()
    model=smf.glm('y ~ treated + C(site_id) + C(month_str)', data=panel_win, family=sm.families.Poisson()).fit(cov_type='cluster', cov_kwds={'groups': panel_win['site_id']}, maxiter=50)
    print(f"twfe r{radius} w{window} {outcome} shift{fake_shift} est {np.exp(model.params['treated'])-1:.3f} p {model.pvalues['treated']:.3f} time {time.time()-start:.1f}s")
    return model

    for it in range(max_iter):

        mu = np.exp(eta); mu=np.clip(mu,1e-8,1e4)
        z = eta + (y - mu)/mu

            den = np.bincount(site_code, weights=w, minlength=n_site)

            a = new_alpha[site_code]

            den2 = np.bincount(month_idx, weights=w, minlength=n_month)
            new_gamma = num2 / np.maximum(den2,1e-8)
            shift=new_gamma[0]; new_gamma-=shift; new_alpha+=shift
            if np.max(np.abs(new_alpha-alpha))<1e-10 and np.max(np.abs(new_gamma-gamma))<1e-10:

        if abs(beta_new-beta)<tol:

    window_df=full[np.abs(full['event_time']) <= window].copy()
    window_df['treated']=(window_df['event_time']>=0).astype(int)

    X=np.zeros((n, p))

    s_map={v:i for i,v in enumerate(uniq_s)}

import statsmodels, pandas as pd
# Check what citywide comparison would give (likely biased to show reduction due to regression to mean)
import itertools, statsmodels.api as sm, statsmodels.formula.api as smf, numpy as np, pandas as pd
sites = pd.read_csv('/tmp/nml_analyst_we05v9rd/sites.csv.gz')
counts = pd.read_csv('/tmp/nml_analyst_we05v9rd/counts.csv.gz')
city = pd.read_csv('/tmp/nml_analyst_we05v9rd/city.csv.gz')
sites['install_month'] = pd.to_datetime(sites['install_month'])
counts['month'] = pd.to_datetime(counts['month'])
city['month'] = pd.to_datetime(city['month'])

# Citywide diff-in-diff estimate: compare site aggregate vs city rest
# Build panel with two units: treated area (all sites 30m) and city
# For each month, site_y = sum over sites of y (ped). Need to align with city_y.
# Then run poisson with unit FE and month FE and interaction.
radius_m=30
outcome='pedestrian_injury_crashes'
sub = counts[counts['radius_m']==radius_m].groupby('month')[outcome].sum().reset_index()
merged = city[['month',outcome]].merge(sub, on='month', how='left', suffixes=('_city','_site'))
merged['site_y'] = merged[outcome+'_site'].fillna(0)
merged['city_y'] = merged[outcome+'_city']
# Define post as weighted? But staggered: need average treatment indicator for site area = share of sites treated
# Compute share treated per month
share = sites.groupby('install_month').size()
months = pd.date_range('2012-07-01','2026-10-01', freq='MS')
share_series = pd.Series(0, index=months)
for im, cnt in share.items():
    im = pd.to_datetime(im)
    mask = months >= im
    share_series[mask] += cnt
share_series = share_series / len(sites) # fraction treated
merged = merged.set_index('month')
merged['share'] = share_series
print(merged.head(20))
# Regression: long format
long = pd.concat([
    merged[['city_y','share']].rename(columns={'city_y':'y'}).assign(unit='city', treated_share=0),
    merged[['site_y','share']].rename(columns={'site_y':'y'}).assign(unit='site', treated_share=lambda x: merged.loc[x.index,'share'])
])
print(long.head())
# Poisson with month FE + unit FE + treated_share
long['month_str']=long.index.astype(str)
long['unit_str']=long['unit']
res=smf.glm('y ~ treated_share + C(unit_str) + C(month_str)', data=long, family=sm.families.Poisson()).fit()
print(res.summary())
est=res.params['treated_share']; se=res.bse['treated_share']
print(f"citywide ped 30m est {(np.exp(est)-1)*100:.1f}% CI [{(np.exp(est-1.96*se)-1)*100:.1f},{(np.exp(est+1.96*se)-1)*100:.1f}] p {res.pvalues['treated_share']:.3f}")
